episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When Miki Anderson returns to Savage River after ten years in prison she's determined to move on with her life, but a murder makes her the focus of everyone's suspicion yet again.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As the town prepares for Savage River's annual celebration, Hugh's disappearance has Colleen worried and Miki hoping that she doesn't become the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Detective Rachel Kennedy begins to investigate the new homicide, town secrets start to emerge, and new motives become apparent.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Detective Rachel Kennedy and Sgt Bill Kirby get closer to solving the mystery, a tip off leads them to the meatworks and the hunt for a murder weapon.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: With Miki back in custody and the meatworks sale almost finalised, new motives come to light and the case takes a new turn.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As the investigation continues, Miki makes the discovery that could identify the real killer.
